summary: Chilton County, AL tower built by the Alabama Forestry Commission in 1949 inside a peach orchard; NHLR-registered 2009 as US 815. Current condition not confirmed.

facts.status_note: The Register does not say whether the tower still stands or what condition it is in; the 'standing' status in our record is not confirmed by any source read

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR detail page and a general 1819 News profile on Alabama lookouts were read. Searches and the Forest Lookouts site (easternuslookouts.weebly.com/peach.html is a 404) gave nothing specific to this tower, so the history is thin. Status, staffing and access are unconfirmed; the record's 'standing' status has no source behind it. A search surfaced a peach-shaped water tower in Clanton, which is a water tower and not this lookout; it was not used. Suggest an Alabama Forestry Commission records request for fate and current status.
